text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the fixes are untested. Please run it to confirm the whole suite passes.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma`, so it returns all three titles.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days late by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text` instead of the nonexistent `catalog.nonexistent`.

I didn't touch any tests.
